run_gmock_doctor: run the Google Mock Doctor CLI to diagnose compiler errors from stdin
diagnose_gmock_errors: diagnose Google Mock compiler error messages and return plain-English explanations
diagnose_return_reference_errors: diagnose compiler errors caused by using Return() instead of ReturnRef() for reference types
diagnose_overloaded_function_errors: diagnose compiler errors from passing overloaded functions to Truly() or Invoke()
diagnose_wrong_mock_method_macro: diagnose compiler errors from using the wrong MOCK_METHODn macro argument count
